lines.text: Zendesk Marketplace lists 1,800+ apps and integrations, against Freshdesk's 1,200 other business apps plus named integrations. Zendesk has the larger catalogue.
lines.reason: the reader: explicit statement that Zendesk's catalogue is larger

lines.text: Zendesk AI agents are pre-trained on over 18 billion real customer interactions. They can resolve requests autonomously and execute tasks such as refunds and order tracking.
Zendesk QA can review 100 percent of tickets.
Zendesk routing can send requests to the right agent based on availability, workload, and expertise.
Zendesk has a published ROI proof point: Lush reached 369 percent ROI in less than one year.
lines.reason: the reader: that Zendesk published or claims this as a proof point

lines.text: Zendesk's startups program gives early-stage startups a 6-month Suite trial for up to 50 agents.
Freshdesk's entry price matches Zendesk's. Growth is $19 per agent per month billed annually, and so is Zendesk Support Team. The $55 tiers also match: Freshdesk Pro and Zendesk Suite Team.
lines.reason: the reader: explicit statement that the prices match

lines.text: Freshdesk Enterprise is $89 per agent per month billed annually. Zendesk Suite Professional is $115 on yearly payment.
Freddy AI Agent is included on all three Freshdesk plans, with 500 free sessions (once per account). Zendesk's own listed con is that advanced AI tools come through paid add-ons.
Freshdesk's free trial gives 14 days of the Enterprise plan, so a prospect can test the top tier.
lines.reason: the reader: enabling prospects to test the top tier

lines.text: Freshdesk parent-child tickets split a complex issue into linked tasks that different agents work on at the same time. Pro and above support multiple SLA policies by customer, product, or priority.
Freshdesk Omni brings live chat, phone, WhatsApp, and expanded social channels into one Command Center.
Thomas Cook cut unresolved tickets by 37% on Freshdesk while total tickets handled rose 55%.
Freshdesk is built for growing teams, typically businesses of 50 to 500 employees.
lines.reason: the reader: that it applies to all growing teams, not just customer service teams

lines.text: Which AI capabilities do you need: a bot that resolves tickets, or agent assist? Have you priced the add-ons for each?
Which third-party apps must your helpdesk connect to, for example Slack, Teams, Shopify, or Mailchimp?
Do your agents work complex issues that would be easier to split into linked tasks across several agents?
Do you need multiple SLA policies by customer, product, or priority? That would put you on Pro or above.
Do you want to support chat, phone, WhatsApp, and social channels from one console?
Would you like to trial the full Enterprise plan for 14 days against your real tickets?

True, Zendesk lists 1,800+. Freshdesk covers Google Workspace, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Shopify, Mailchimp and 1,200 other business apps, and it has developer documentation for custom apps. Let's check that your must-have tools are on the list.
lines.objection: Zendesk has far more apps in its marketplace.

lines.text: Freshdesk includes Freddy AI Agent on every plan, with 500 free sessions, so you can test it on your own tickets before you pay for AI. Zendesk's own listed con is that advanced AI tools are paid add-ons.
lines.objection: Zendesk's AI agents can resolve tickets on their own.
lines.reason: the reader: it adds a fact its citations do not state (Zendesk's AI agents can resolve tickets on their own)

lines.text: At entry level the prices do match: $19 for Growth and for Support Team. At the top, Freshdesk Enterprise is $89 against $115 for Zendesk Suite Professional. You can also try Enterprise free for 14 days.
lines.objection: Zendesk costs the same as Freshdesk, so why switch?

lines.text: Freshdesk has one too. Thomas Cook cut unresolved tickets by 37% while handling 55% more tickets.
lines.objection: Zendesk has a proven ROI story.
